The '''2/181st''' was the second [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of the [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Wing]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. The squadron [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] and [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]]. The squadron was commanded by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], who led the 2/181st through the [[Second Battle of Ord Biniir]]. Following the [[Battle of Derra IV]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], command of the 2/181st was given to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir]], who continued to lead the squadron until the [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Brentaal IV]] in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].
